expectedMisconceptions: A pattern spotted in only one or two datasets can get generalised to 'all the data' without checking it actually holds across every dataset compared.
A genuine trend can be confused with a single unusual data point — worth asking whether the pattern still holds if that one point is set aside.
stretchQuestions: Would your conclusion survive if you removed one of your datasets and only used the rest? What does that tell you about how strong the pattern is?
What evidence would change your mind about this trend?
estimatedSupervision: Minimal — independent graphing and reasoning; a parent might enjoy hearing which earlier missions the child thinks the pattern connects.
